title: Yharnam Together 1.0: chalice dungeons as a team
intro: The first full release. Each of you enters a chalice dungeon from your own altar, bosses keep one runner for the whole fight, and what a teammate opens is open for everyone.
notes: Chalice dungeons: the host stepping into a dungeon no longer takes teammates standing in the Hunter's Dream along (they fell into the void). Each of you enters from your own altar, in any order.
Chalice dungeons: no multiplayer fog walls, guests open the boss door, bosses are handed out again and big enemies no longer lag.
Bosses keep one runner for the whole fight, and only the game's real bosses are handed out.
Doors, gates and levers a teammate opens are open for the whole party; guests open the Research Hall's door and device and pick up the workshop's glowing items.

Guests away from the host follow the host's story steps live; a map everyone died on starts over while others stand elsewhere; kills reach players who arrive later; summoned enemies that come back are shown to everyone again.
Fewer crashes after a host rejoins.

info.title: First time here
info.text: Open Co-op, point it at your Bloodborne folder and type the host's IP. The host types their own address and PLAY starts the server for them.

info.title: Make a team
info.text: Press Continue, Load Game or New Game: the team screen opens. Invite hunters online, ready up, and the leader begins the hunt.

info.title: In the game
info.text: Insert or L3 + R3 opens the port's menu: graphics, controls and the Co-op Team page, where you can invite or remove players.
